reviews.text: I highly recommend Angela, Mike, and Austin.  In my opinion,  this is the hardest working pool team I've met. I have been researching fiberglass pools for at least 3 to 4 years, weighing the pros and cons. From the very first time I met with Angela Wagner, I knew this was the company to install my pool. She and her team are so genuine, real and down to earth. They really make you feel like family. They are a wealth of knowledge about the pool industry. They answered every question I had with no hesitation. I am extremely pleased with the entire process, which didn't take long at all.  From the digging of the hole to the setting of the pool, to the concrete work, may have taken 2 1/2 weeks tops. If you are looking for a top notch,  highly professional,  down to earth business to install your fiberglass pool, Crystal Edge is hands down the best in town!
reviews.author: Barry G Samples

reviews.text: Great experience from start to finish! The team did a great job communicating timelines, work was completed without any issues, and the pool has met & exceeded our expectations. As a first time pool owner they’ve been extremely patient & responsive with our periodic random questions.
reviews.author: Gillettie Ravin

reviews.text: I would highly recommend using Crystal Edge Pools if you are in the market for an in ground fiberglass pool. I’ve only had gunite pools my entire life and I’m very happy with how the fiberglass pool turned out. It’s beautiful and much easier to maintain so far. Angela and Mike have done a fantastic job and are people of integrity. It’s hard to find that in todays world, especially in the pool business. I will definitely be recommending them to all of my friends and family. I’m very pleased with the pool and their professionalism and responsiveness.
reviews.author: Keely Franks-Kennedy

reviews.text: We just got our Crystal Edge pool fully installed. Even with all the rain they got the whole project completed in 2.5 weeks. It looks great and so easy to maintain. Working with Mike, Angela and Austin was just amazing! If you want a beautiful pool that’s easy to maintain and completed in weeks give these people a call.
reviews.author: James Simmonds

reviews.text: My pool installation went smooth. Which is great and even better three years later we’re still getting support from the great team of Mike, Angela and  Austin! If you’re looking for a quality company go with Crystal Edge Pools, llc. You won’t be disappointed. Also. If you’re waffling between a larger size, go with as big as you can. You’ll be glad in the long run. By the way, those little alligators and bouncy dolphin keep the ducks away which means no duck poo to clean! Happy swim season.
reviews.author: Linda Harrington

reviews.text:
We absolutely love our pool from Crystal Edge Pools. Angela and Mike were great to work with. Even with some last minute changes on our part the install only took about a week and a half to complete.
Having had a gunite pool in the past that always had a green hue to it, we wanted to make sure our new pool was always blue. We selected a standard blue that we could not be more pleased with. The pool is much easier to maintain than a gunite pool and much easier on your body/feet when you swim in it. We also love the safety channel and step all around the pool.
We could not be happier with our pool selection and our choice to go with Crystal Edge Pools.
reviews.author: Kevin Bird

reviews.text: From start to finish Crystal Edge was upfront and professional about the pool prices and installation process. We have referred several of our friends to them thanks for a wonderful pool experience Angela.
reviews.author: James Bursey

reviews.text: Alsome pool builder,  I have had my pool now for 18 months everything still work like the first day.  Mike and Angela are alsome to work with.  If you are in need of a pool they are the ones for the job.
reviews.author: jeffery chavers
